cases.question: How many days of paid time off do full-time employees get each year?
cases.answer: Full-time employees receive 25 days of paid time off per calendar year, accrued monthly [S1].

cases.question: How many unused vacation days can I carry over, and when do they expire?
cases.answer: Up to 5 unused days can be carried over into the next year; carried-over days expire on March 31 [S1].

cases.question: How long is paid parental leave for a primary caregiver?
cases.answer: Primary caregivers receive 20 weeks of fully paid parental leave [S1].

cases.question: What is the annual learning and development budget?
cases.answer: Every employee has an annual learning and development budget of $2,000 [S1].

cases.question: How much is the home office stipend for new hires?
cases.answer: New hires receive a laptop of their choice (MacBook Pro or ThinkPad X1) and a one-time $750 home-office stipend [S1].

cases.question: What are the core collaboration hours?
cases.answer: Core collaboration hours are 10:00 to 15:00 Eastern Time, Monday to Friday [S1].

cases.question: In which review cycle are promotions decided?
cases.answer: Promotions are decided by a calibration committee in the October cycle only [S1].

cases.question: What is the minimum password length?
cases.answer: I don't have enough information in the documents you can access to answer that.

cases.question: What kind of authentication is required for production access?
cases.answer: Multi-factor authentication is mandatory for all company systems, and hardware security keys (FIDO2) are required for production access [S1].

cases.question: How quickly must access be revoked for departing employees?
cases.answer: Access for departing employees must be revoked within 4 hours of their last working day [S1].

cases.question: How soon do I need to report a suspected security incident?
cases.answer: Suspected security incidents must be reported in the #sec-incidents Slack channel or to [REDACTED:EMAIL] within 1 hour of discovery [S1].

cases.question: After how many minutes of inactivity must laptops auto-lock?
cases.answer: Laptops must use full-disk encryption and auto-lock after 5 minutes of inactivity [S1].

cases.question: What is the hotel cap per night in New York?
cases.answer: The nightly hotel cap is $250 in most cities and $350 in high-cost cities: New York, San Francisco, London and Zurich [S1].

cases.question: What is the daily meal allowance when travelling?
cases.answer: The daily meal allowance while travelling is $85 [S1].

cases.question: Who has to approve business class flights?
cases.answer: Economy class is required for flights under 6 hours; premium economy is allowed for flights of 6 hours or longer [S1]. Business class requires VP approval [S1].

cases.question: Within how many days must expenses be submitted?
cases.answer: Expenses must be submitted in Ramp within 30 days with an itemized receipt for any purchase over $25 [S1].

cases.question: How much does the Starter plan cost?
cases.answer: The Starter plan costs $499 per month and covers up to 50 monitored tables [S1]. The Growth plan costs $1,999 per month and covers up to 500 tables [S1].

cases.question: What service credit do enterprise customers get if uptime drops below 99.9%?
cases.answer: Enterprise customers receive a 99.9% monthly uptime SLA [S1]. If uptime falls below 99.9%, customers receive a 10% service credit; below 99.0%, the credit rises to 25% [S1].

cases.question: Which AWS region can EU customers choose for data residency?
cases.answer: Customer metadata is stored in AWS us-east-1 by default [S1]. EU customers can choose eu-central-1 (Frankfurt) at no extra cost [S1]. Helix never copies raw row-level customer data; it reads only aggregates and schema metadata [S1].

cases.question: How soon after a SEV1 is declared must the first status page update be published?
cases.answer: For SEV1 incidents, the first status page update must be published within 15 minutes of declaration, then every 30 minutes until resolution [S1].

cases.question: Within how many hours must regulators be notified of a data breach?
cases.answer: Regulators and affected customers must be notified within 72 hours of confirming a breach, as required under GDPR [S1].

cases.question: What command rolls back a production deploy?
cases.answer: Every production deploy must be reversible [S1]. The rollback command is helixctl deploy rollback --to previous, and it must be executed by someone with the prod-deployer role [S1].

cases.question: How much is the annual Datadog contract?
cases.answer: Datadog is used for infrastructure monitoring under an annual contract of $310,000 that renews on August 1 [S1].

cases.question: What is the size of the AWS Enterprise Discount Program commitment?
cases.answer: Helix's primary cloud provider is AWS under a 3-year Enterprise Discount Program commitment of $4.2 million, signed in January 2025 and expiring in January 2028 [S1].

cases.question: What is the base salary band for a Staff Engineer?
cases.answer: Software Engineer II (L3) base salary band: $135,000 to $165,000 [S1].

cases.question: What was Q3 2026 revenue?
cases.answer: Q3 2026 revenue was $14.8 million, up 38% year over year [S1].

cases.question: What is the codename for the Lumen Analytics acquisition?
cases.answer: The leadership team recommends acquiring Lumen Analytics, a data-lineage startup, for approximately $22 million in cash and stock [S1].
